cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: no strong anionic; earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate @2 with prominent amphoteric co-surfactants Lauramidopropyl Betaine @3 and Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 (C3, C4, C6).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: the only conditioning route is Polyquaternium-10 @11, after the fragrance and preservatives (trace), plus a late Glycerin @24. Cleansing-led architecture with little substantive slip (Section 5). The cationic polymer makes moderate the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.persistence: low-to-moderate - PQ-10 can build up, but only at trace level
weightPotential.counterevidence: Weak reset lets even a small PQ-10 accumulate.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A single trace cationic polymer with no reinforcing family.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: one deposition family only (Polyquaternium-10 @11, post-fragrance and post-preservative trace), no silicone, lipid, protein or refatter to converge with it; one route kind is not a moderate floor (6.6).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Weak reset could allow PQ-10 buildup
weightPotential.rationale: Low: single trace PQ-10, weak reset recorded as counter-signal (6.6, W2). Neighbor moderate.
